requirements.title: Choose a business structure
requirements.evidence: You’ll need to choose a business structure before you register your business with the state.
requirements.why: You have one owner and chose sole proprietorship. Structure affects taxes and liability.
requirements.background: Every business operates under a legal form, and you plan to operate alone as a sole proprietor, so you should settle that choice in your plan.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote does not mention sole proprietorship, one owner, taxes, or liability.

requirements.title: Register trade name Oneota Hive & Balm
requirements.evidence: It shall be unlawful for any person or copartnership to engage in or conduct a business under any trade name, or any assumed name of any character other than the true surname of each person or persons owning or having any interest in such business, unless such person or persons shall first file with the county recorder of the county in which the business is to be conducted a verified statement showing the name, postoffice address, and residence address of each person owning or having any interest in the business, and the address where the business is to be conducted.
requirements.why: You will use Oneota Hive & Balm, not your legal name, in Winneshiek County.
requirements.background: Iowa businesses that sell under a name other than the owner's legal name generally register that name where they do business, and you will use a separate brand name.
problems: Quote not found on the cited pages

requirements.title: Get Iowa sales and use tax permit
requirements.evidence: A person shall not make taxable sales of tangible property, specified digital products, or services until the person has received a permit from the department.
requirements.why: You sell honey jars and balm at markets and by in-state shipment.

requirements.title: Follow Iowa cottage food rules for raw honey
requirements.agency: Iowa Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing
requirements.evidence: Cottage food is exempt from all licensing, permitting, inspection, packaging, and labeling laws of the state if the food is sold and delivered by the producer directly to the consumer, or delivered by mail or an agent of the producer such as an employee.
requirements.why: You make shelf-stable honey at home for direct sale in person and by mail.
requirements.background: You prepare shelf stable honey at home and sell it direct to buyers, which fits the home cottage food path, so you must meet its labeling and direct sale rules.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote discusses cottage food generally and does not mention raw honey.

requirements.title: Label honey honestly
requirements.agency: Iowa Department of Agriculture and Land Stewardship
requirements.evidence: No person shall package any liquid or semisolid product or label any such product as honey, imitation honey or honey blend, or use the word "honey" in any prominent location on the label of such product or sell or offer for sale any such product which is labeled as honey, imitation honey or honey blend or which contains a label with the word "honey" prominently displayed thereon, unless the entire product is honey as defined in section 190.1, subsection 4.
requirements.why: You sell raw honey using the word honey on jars and ads.

requirements.title: Make and label lip balm safely
requirements.evidence: If you manufacture or market cosmetics, you have a legal responsibility for the safety and labeling of your products.
requirements.why: You make beeswax lip balm at home to sell.
requirements.background: Lip balm sold to customers counts as a cosmetic under long standing federal law, which requires safe making and truthful labeling.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote discusses cosmetics generally and does not mention lip balm or beeswax.

requirements.title: Check cosmetic facility registration
conditions: Will your cosmetic sales stay small enough to count as a small business?
requirements.evidence: MoCRA exempts certain small businesses from facility registration and product listing.
requirements.why: It depends on your sales size whether home balm site must be registered.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote does not mention sales size or a home balm site.

requirements.title: Get federal tax ID (EIN) if you want one
requirements.evidence: It’s free to apply for an EIN, and you should do it right after you register your business.
requirements.why: You are a sole proprietor with no employees and may use SSN but EIN helps.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote does not mention sole proprietors with no employees, SSN use, or that EIN use is optional.

requirements.title: File Iowa sales and use tax returns
requirements.evidence: IMPORTANT: You must file even if you had no activity. If you have no tax to report, enter zeros on Lines 5, 9, and 18.
requirements.why: Once permitted, you must file returns for market and website sales.

requirements.title: File yearly federal income and self-employment taxes
requirements.evidence: April 15th each year is the due date for filing your federal individual income tax return.
requirements.why: As sole proprietor you report honey and balm profit and pay Social Security and Medicare tax.
requirements.background: A sole proprietor generally reports business profit on the yearly personal return and pays self employment tax on that profit.
problems: The quote doesn’t show this requirement: The quote only mentions the due date for the federal individual income tax return and does not show self-employment, Social Security, or Medicare tax obligations.

requirements.evidence: Cottage food is exempt from all licensing, permitting, inspection, packaging, and labeling laws of the state if the food is sold and delivered by the producer directly to the consumer, or delivered by mail or an agent of the producer such as an employee. A producer may sell food to the consumer in person, remotely, by telephone, by internet, or by an agent of the producer.

openQuestions.question: We couldn’t find an official page about business licenses in Winneshiek County. That doesn’t mean nothing applies, so ask.
openQuestions.answer: No county page was found to settle this, so ask the county auditor or recorder whether a home seller at markets and online needs any general county license.

openQuestions.question: We couldn’t find an official page about food permits from the Winneshiek County health department. That doesn’t mean nothing applies, so ask.
openQuestions.answer: State rules treat home cottage foods as not subject to licensing or inspection, but to be safe ask the county health office to confirm that no market clearance is needed for raw honey.

openQuestions.question: Our search for official pages about business licenses in Decorah didn’t finish. Re-check later, or ask.
openQuestions.answer: Our search of city pages did not finish, so ask the city clerk whether Decorah requires any local business license or registration before you open.

openQuestions.question: We couldn’t find an official page about running a business from home in Decorah. That doesn’t mean nothing applies, so ask.
openQuestions.answer: No city home business page was found, so ask city zoning or the clerk what home occupation rules apply to your address and activities.

openQuestions.question: Are raw honey and lip balm taxable and what local tax applies in Decorah?
openQuestions.answer: Jars of honey and lip balm sold in state are generally taxable retail sales. Most local areas also add a local option sales tax on top of state tax, which you collect where the sale takes place and report by county on the state return.

openQuestions.question: Does small-business exemption cover home lip-balm registration and listing?
openQuestions.answer: This cannot be settled from the pages found. Federal cosmetic law still requires safe making and truthful labeling even for a very small home maker, so check current federal guidance or ask the agency whether any facility filing duty applies to you.

openQuestions.question: Does Decorah require a general business license or registration for a home-based sole proprietorship like this?
openQuestions.answer: No city page was found to settle this, so ask the city clerk whether a home based sole proprietor with no shop and no customer visits needs a Decorah license or registration.

openQuestions.question: What home-occupation and residential zoning rules apply to making and storing honey and lip balm at a home in Decorah with no customer visits?
openQuestions.answer: No city zoning page was found, so ask city zoning whether making, packing and storing honey and balm at your house is allowed in your neighborhood and whether any home occupation approval or limits apply.

openQuestions.question: Do I need a county temporary food or market vendor clearance to sell raw honey at farmers markets, given Iowa cottage-food rules?
openQuestions.answer: Under state pages, honey and cottage foods sold direct are treated as not subject to licensing and as allowed at farmers markets without a market license, so a separate county market clearance does not appear needed. Confirm with the market manager and county health office before your first market.

conflicts.about: Whether FDA honey guidance is mandatory
conflicts.explanation: FDA honey page says guidances do not establish legally enforceable responsibilities and should be viewed only as recommendations, so mandatory labeling is unclear.

conflicts.about: How to file Iowa trade name
conflicts.explanation: 1925 Iowa law says file verified statement with county recorder, while SBA says DBA rules vary by state, county and city, leaving current form and fee unclear.
